description: Run the ownership check for one of the project's domains now, and answer with the result. Call it after the DNS record is published. The check reaches the DNS and is rate-limited behind a certificate budget, so poll it in minutes rather than in seconds. A domain still unproven 48 hours after attach_domain is failed for good, and this answers domain_failed for it: delete_domain, fix the record and attach_domain again.
name: check_domain
title: Check domain ownership
